svg.aria-label: Diagram of the Mintmark family topology. A single hub repository named mintmark holds the engine: generation, identifiers, annotation, manifests, and the command line interface. Three sector pack repositories hang from it, mintmark-banking, mintmark-insurance, and mintmark-hr, each carrying declarations and data with no engine code. A fourth, health, is drawn dashed and marked deferred because its special-category density needs its own governance review. Each pack pins the engine by a version range with a closed upper bound.
svg.title: The Mintmark family topology
svg.desc: One engine repository with three sector pack repositories hanging from it, and a fourth deferred.

svg.text: Engine logic never duplicates into a pack, so a fix reaches every sector at once.
